_comment: 9 segments, 8 cuts. THREE cuts carry a real Adelaide cutaway; per reels/README.md B-roll only ever sits over a connecting/filler phrase, so the count is script-judged, not fixed. The three chosen spots are the only genuine connectors in this script: (1) 5.85s, he re-introduces the city -- 'Adelaide is widely recognized as...' -- so the cutaway literally shows the place he is naming; (2) 14.30s, 'Combine that with the...' is a pure linking phrase into the nomination program; (3) 29.35s, 'And hence we are breaking this down in our...' is a pure linking phrase into the roadshow CTA. Nothing sits over the visa/eligibility detail. The remaining 5 cuts get extra_wipes instead, and NO transition style repeats across the reel: grid/speed/flash come from build_wipe.py, cyan/bars/iris/speedcyan/flashcyan from this reel's wipes_cyan.py.
